001package io.github.ai4ci;
002
003import java.lang.annotation.ElementType;
004import java.lang.annotation.Retention;
005import java.lang.annotation.RetentionPolicy;
006import java.lang.annotation.Target;
007
008import org.immutables.value.Value;
009import org.immutables.value.Value.Style.ValidationMethod;
010
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
012import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeName;
013import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
014import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
015// import com.j256.simplecsv.common.CsvColumn;
016import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize.Typing;
017
018import io.github.ai4ci.config.Scale;
019import io.github.ai4ci.flow.output.Export;
020
021/**
022 * Central annotation for configuring Immutables value types with consistent
023 * styling and Jackson serialization support across the codebase.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * This annotation and its nested styles provide standardized configurations for
027 * Immutables-generated value types, ensuring consistency in:
028 * <ul>
029 * <li>Accessor method naming patterns</li>
030 * <li>Builder initialization patterns</li>
031 * <li>Jackson serialization/deserialization behavior</li>
032 * <li>Hash code, equals, and toString implementations</li>
033 * <li>Pluralization handling for collection properties</li>
034 * </ul>
035 *
036 * <h2>Usage Examples</h2>
037 *
038 * <pre>
039 * {@code @Data.Style}
040 * public interface Person {
041 *     String getName();
042 *     int getAge();
043 * }
044 * </pre>
045 *
046 * <p>
047 * Each nested annotation provides specialized styling for different use cases
048 * while maintaining overall consistency across the codebase.
049 *
050 * @see Value.Style
051 * @see JsonSerialize
052 * @see JsonDeserialize
053 */
054public @interface Data {
055
056        /**
057         * Mutable value type style for modifiable data structures.
058         *
059         * <p>
060         * This style configures types that support mutation with:
061         * <ul>
062         * <li>Standard getter patterns: {@code is*} for booleans, {@code get*} for
063         * others</li>
064         * <li>Builder initialization with {@code set*} methods</li>
065         * <li>Constructor creation with {@code new} instead of builder</li>
066         * <li>Deep immutables detection for nested immutable types</li>
067         * <li>{@code with*} methods for creating modified copies</li>
068         * <li>Automatic toBuilder() implementation</li>
069         * <li>Custom hashCode, equals, and toString underrides</li>
070         * <li>Pluralization support with custom dictionary</li>
071         * </ul>
072         *
073         * <p>
074         * <b>Target Usage:</b> Mutable data structures and configuration objects
075         * where immutability is not required.
076         */
077        @Target({ ElementType.PACKAGE, ElementType.TYPE })
078        @Retention(RetentionPolicy.CLASS)
079        @JsonSerialize(typing = Typing.DYNAMIC)
080        @JsonDeserialize
081        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
082        @Value.Style(
083                        get = { "is*", "get*" },
084                        init = "set*",
085                        create = "new",
086                        deepImmutablesDetection = true,
087                        with = "with*",
088                        toBuilder = "toBuilder",
089                        strictBuilder = false,
090                        strictModifiable = false,
091                        underrideHashCode = "hash",
092                        underrideEquals = "equality",
093                        underrideToString = "print",
094                        isSet = "initialised*",
095                        depluralize = true,
096                        depluralizeDictionary = { "person:people" },
097                        jdk9Collections = true
098        )
099        public static @interface Mutable {}
100
101        /**
102         * Partial value type style for configuration modifications and patches.
103         *
104         * <p>
105         * This style configures partial types used for:
106         * <ul>
107         * <li>Configuration modifications and overrides</li>
108         * <li>Partial object updates and patches</li>
109         * <li>Demographic adjustment scaling operations</li>
110         * </ul>
111         *
112         * <p>
113         * Key characteristics:
114         * <ul>
115         * <li>Standard getter patterns</li>
116         * <li>Builder initialization with {@code set*} methods</li>
117         * <li>No deep immutables detection (performance optimization)</li>
118         * <li>DemographicAdjustment.Scale annotation pass-through</li>
119         * <li>Type naming pattern: {@code _Partial*} for abstract, {@code Partial*}
120         * for immutable</li>
121         * <li>Custom hashCode, equals, and toString underrides</li>
122         * <li>Pluralization support with custom dictionary</li>
123         * <li>Validation disabled for partial objects</li>
124         * </ul>
125         *
126         * <p>
127         * <b>Target Usage:</b> Configuration patches, demographic adjustments, and
128         * partial object updates.
129         *
130         * @see Scale
131         */
132        @Target({ ElementType.PACKAGE, ElementType.TYPE })
133        @Retention(RetentionPolicy.CLASS)
134        @JsonSerialize(typing = Typing.DYNAMIC)
135        @JsonTypeInfo(use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME)
136        @JsonDeserialize
137        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
138        @Value.Style(
139                        get = { "is*", "get*" },
140                        init = "set*",
141                        deepImmutablesDetection = false,
142                        passAnnotations = { Scale.class, Export.class, Import.class,
143                                        JsonTypeName.class, JsonTypeInfo.class },
144                        typeAbstract = "_Partial*",
145                        typeImmutable = "Partial*",
146                        strictModifiable = false,
147                        depluralize = true,
148                        underrideHashCode = "hash",
149                        underrideEquals = "equality",
150                        underrideToString = "print",
151                        depluralizeDictionary = { "person:people" },
152                        validationMethod = ValidationMethod.NONE,
153                        jdk9Collections = true
154        )
155        public static @interface Partial {}
156
157        /**
158         * Repository-style configuration for data access objects and persistence
159         * entities.
160         *
161         * <p>
162         * This style optimizes types for repository and data access patterns with:
163         * <ul>
164         * <li>Standard getter patterns</li>
165         * <li>Builder initialization with {@code set*} methods</li>
166         * <li>{@code with*} methods for creating modified copies</li>
167         * <li>Automatic toBuilder() implementation</li>
168         * <li>Custom hashCode, equals, and toString underrides</li>
169         * <li>Export and Import annotation pass-through</li>
170         * <li>Pluralization support with custom dictionary</li>
171         * <li>Initialization state tracking with {@code initialised*} methods</li>
172         * </ul>
173         *
174         * <p>
175         * <b>Target Usage:</b> Data access objects, repository entities, and
176         * persistence-layer models requiring export/import capabilities.
177         *
178         * @see Export
179         * @see Import
180         */
181        @Target({ ElementType.PACKAGE, ElementType.TYPE })
182        @Retention(RetentionPolicy.CLASS)
183        @JsonSerialize(typing = Typing.DYNAMIC)
184        @JsonDeserialize
185        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
186        @Value.Style(
187                        get = { "is*", "get*" },
188                        init = "set*",
189                        deepImmutablesDetection = false,
190                        with = "with*",
191                        toBuilder = "toBuilder",
192                        strictBuilder = false,
193                        underrideHashCode = "hash",
194                        underrideEquals = "equality",
195                        underrideToString = "print",
196                        strictModifiable = false,
197                        passAnnotations = { Export.class, Import.class },
198                        isSet = "initialised*",
199                        depluralize = true,
200                        depluralizeDictionary = { "person:people" },
201                        jdk9Collections = true
202        )
203        public static @interface Repository {}
204
205        /**
206         * Standard immutable value type style with full Immutables feature support.
207         *
208         * <p>
209         * This style configures immutable types with:
210         * <ul>
211         * <li>Standard getter patterns: {@code is*} for booleans, {@code get*} for
212         * others</li>
213         * <li>Builder initialization with {@code set*} methods</li>
214         * <li>Deep immutables detection for nested immutable types</li>
215         * <li>{@code with*} methods for creating modified copies</li>
216         * <li>Automatic toBuilder() implementation</li>
217         * <li>Custom hashCode, equals, and toString underrides</li>
218         * <li>Pluralization support with custom dictionary</li>
219         * <li>Export and Import annotation pass-through</li>
220         * </ul>
221         *
222         * <p>
223         * <b>Target Usage:</b> General-purpose immutable data transfer objects and
224         * domain models requiring full Immutables feature set.
225         *
226         * @see Export
227         * @see Import
228         */
229        @Target({ ElementType.PACKAGE, ElementType.TYPE })
230        @Retention(RetentionPolicy.CLASS)
231        @JsonSerialize(typing = Typing.DYNAMIC)
232        @JsonTypeInfo(use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME)
233        @JsonDeserialize
234        @SuppressWarnings("immutable")
235        @Value.Style(
236                        // Detect 'get' and 'is' prefixes in accessor methods
237                        get = { "is*", "get*" },
238                        // Builder initialization methods will have 'set' prefix
239                        init = "set*",
240                        deepImmutablesDetection = true,
241                        with = "with*",
242                        toBuilder = "toBuilder",
243                        strictBuilder = false,
244                        underrideHashCode = "hash",
245                        underrideEquals = "equality",
246                        underrideToString = "print",
247                        strictModifiable = false,
248                        passAnnotations = { Export.class, Import.class, JsonTypeName.class,
249                                        JsonTypeInfo.class },
250                        isSet = "initialised*",
251                        depluralize = true,
252                        depluralizeDictionary = { "person:people" },
253                        jdk9Collections = true
254        )
255        public static @interface Style {}
256
257}
